name: Monk Kensai
body:
The kensai is a weapon saint dedicated to the perfection of self, ki, and harmony through absolute mastery of a single iconic weapon.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Proficient with all weapons from a single fighter weapon group, plus light armor. This replaces standard monk weapon and armor proficiencies.

AC Bonus (Ex)

Functions as normal for a monk, but lost when immobilized, helpless, wearing medium or heavy armor, carrying a shield, or carrying a medium or heavy load.

Flurry of Blows (Ex)

Can make a flurry of blows using unarmed strikes or attacks with his living ki weapon. Cannot flurry with other weapons (including monk weapons).

Living Ki Weapon (Su)

Begins play with a masterwork weapon from his chosen group (or +1 competence bonus to attacks if unarmed strike or natural weapons). Once per day, 1 hour of practice attunes ki to a new proficient weapon (retargeting single-weapon feats like Weapon Focus). Only one weapon can be attuned at a time.

As a standard action, expend ki focus to grant the weapon a +1 enhancement bonus for 1 minute per kensai level at 4th level, increasing by +1 every two levels beyond 4th (max +9 at 20th level). Stacks with existing weapon bonuses up to +5, or can add: axiomatic, brilliant energy, defending, disruption, flaming, flaming burst, holy, keen, merciful, speed, unholy. Must add at least +1 before special properties. Double weapon bonuses split between ends. Usable 1/day at 4th, +1/day every 5 levels thereafter (4/day at 19th). Replaces Stunning Fist and slow fall.

Multiclassing: Arcane bonded weapons or paladin divinely bonded weapons can serve as living ki weapons (stacking paladin and kensai levels for enhancement bonus, activated via ki focus). If destroyed, the kensai loses this ability and takes a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls for 30 days or until gaining a level.

Living Ki Weapon Damage (Ex)

Deals scaled base damage with his living ki weapon while ki focused, as shown below. Ranged living ki weapons only apply this damage within 60 feet. This replaces standard monk unarmed damage.

Kensai Level	Small Kensai	Medium Kensai	Large Kensai
1st–3rd	1d4	1d6	1d8
4th–7th	1d6	1d8	2d6
8th–11th	1d8	1d10	2d8
12th–15th	1d10	2d6	3d6
16th–19th	2d6	2d8	3d8
20th	2d8	2d10	4d8
Unarmed Strike (Ex)

Gains Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. Deals 1d6 damage (1d4 if Small, 1d8 if Large), unless chosen as his living ki weapon.

Bonus Feats

Adds the following bonus feats: 2nd—Weapon Focus; 10th—Weapon Specialization; 14th—Greater Weapon Focus; 18th—Greater Weapon Specialization (all apply to living ki weapon).

Ki Strike (Su)

At 4th level, attacks count as magic. At 10th level, attacks count as jade (overcoming DR and dealing +2d6 damage to Infernals). At 16th level, attacks count as adamantine. Class ki pool otherwise functions as normal.

Martial Training (Ex)

At 6th level, counts as a fighter of level – 4 for combat feat prerequisites. This replaces the 6th-level monk bonus feat.

Weapon of the Golden Soul (Su)

At 20th level, during combat, the living ki weapon awakens as an intelligent item (base price modifier up to +12,000 gp; ego equals attributes + kensai Wisdom modifier). The weapon permanently transmutates into jade with the hardness of adamantine (unarmed skin turns greenish-jade; teeth/claws become jade-adamantine). Retains all magical enhancements permanently, swappable 1/day via 1 hour meditation. All other weapons are treated as improvised (-4 penalty). If destroyed, must wait 30 days before awakening a replacement. Other creatures treat it as improvised; if the kensai dies, an unarmed/natural version distills into an intelligent sash. This replaces perfect self.

Rules: Infernals & Jade

Infernals: Creatures unsanctioned by the Celestial Bureaucracy, including the Aberration type, Fey type, Goblinoid subtype, Incorporeal subtype, and Outsider type.

Jade Material: Jade weapons/ammunition have the bane property (+2 attack/damage, +2d6 damage) against Infernals. Jade armor grants Spell Resistance against Infernals (Light: SR 13; Medium: SR 15; Heavy: SR 17). Cost Modifiers: Ammunition +60 gp/missile; Light Armor +5,000 gp; Medium Armor +10,000 gp; Heavy Armor +15,000 gp; Weapon +3,000 gp.
